scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix db && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix web && npm run type-check --prefix server
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix db
